brief: 彩色像素兔子，安静倾听呼吸态与睡眠待机态；通过耳朵、轮廓与姿态形成品牌记忆。此次只探索四个核心方向，包含回应关键姿态和一个图标方向，不制作全套动画或图标包。
review: 待用户选择核心方向；生成图中的纹理、栅格和小尺寸表现需在选定后进一步规范，不能直接当生产精灵。

animationIntent.listening: 胸腹轻微呼吸、低频眨眼，脚底与整体位置稳定，不随音量跳动。
animationIntent.sleep: 闭眼松耳，幅度更小、节奏更慢的待机呼吸，不飘 Z。
animationIntent.hover: 一次转耳与好奇歪头，再回倾听；不持续跟随鼠标。
animationIntent.pause: 合眼收耳的短过渡，只在真实采集停止后进入睡眠。
animationIntent.resume: 小伸展、耳朵立起；待实际采集恢复后回倾听。
animationIntent.success: 轻点头或小幅抬爪一次；不延迟面板收起、不影响评论焦点。
animationIntent.exception: 清醒垂耳的静态姿态，按 PRD 一次轻提醒，避免委屈/哭泣循环。

variants.name: 奶油鼠尾草
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / logo-brand.
Asset type: a premium mascot character exploration sheet for hear, a calm desktop listening/journaling app. This is an early designer concept board, NOT a final production sprite sheet.
Subject: an original colorful PIXEL ART rabbit, emotionally gentle, attentive and quietly companionable, appropriate for adult professional users. Character must read at 24–40 px beside a dark Mac camera notch and also become an app icon. No microphones, headphones, recording dots, waveforms, timers, Z letters, sparkles, speech bubbles or other props. No borrowed established character. Not photorealistic, not 3D, not smooth vector art disguised as pixels. All character shapes use deliberately placed square pixels on a consistent coarse grid, crisp edges, flat limited colors, no blurred pixel edges or textures. Keep the same character proportions, markings and color system across every pose within the board. Head and ear silhouette is more important than elaborate details. Small eyes, tiny nose, restrained expression.
Composition: clean landscape editorial design sheet on warm off-white, generous whitespace, very little typography, strong hierarchy, balanced alignment. Heading top-left is the option letter and short Chinese name, below it small 'hear / 角色探索'. Two large full-body poses in the upper half, exactly the SAME rabbit identity: left calmly LISTENING seated upright with ears attentive and a tiny soft chest, right ASLEEP with closed eyes, ears gently relaxed and body slightly settled, identical seated footprint and ground baseline. Small labels '倾听' and '睡觉'. In lower half, three medium-size small sequential poses labelled '回应' show an understated hover acknowledgement: neutral, slight ear swivel/head tilt toward user, then gentle return. At bottom include a minimal dark charcoal horizontal strip with a tiny rabbit and a white horizontal strip with the same tiny rabbit, demonstrating small-silhouette readability. At lower right one app-icon DIRECTION study only, a rounded-square tile with the SAME rabbit head/ears, carefully composed, flat quiet background. No complete icon pack, no device mockups. Board labels only as specified, no paragraphs or color swatch metadata. The sleep rabbit must still unmistakably be the same rabbit, not a different lying-down animal. Display square-pixel construction beautifully and coherently.
Heading exactly 'A  奶油鼠尾草'. Direction A: the most timeless and warm option. Cream-ivory compact seated rabbit, sage-green pixel outline (not heavy black), soft pistachio shadow planes, subtle warm blush inner ears and a very tiny moss-green neck marking as its identifying accent, no clothes. Full body about a 28x38 logical pixel grid. Head has an elegant softly stepped-square shape, eye spacing calm rather than baby-like. Two distinct long but not excessive ears, one ear's last pixel bends gently inward as a recognizable signature. Little grounded paws, no oversized eye highlights. Around six colors. Thoughtful quiet companion with 1990s handcrafted pixel warmth, refined contemporary brand execution. App icon: deep sage square field and a large cream rabbit head with the asymmetric ear tip, not a full-body rabbit lost inside a tile.
